digest.component_or_area: LLM completion verification and recovery workflow orchestration
propositions: completion.py and completion_recovery.py each exceed the 800 LOC module-size CI gate and require architectural decomposition along existing call-graph seams
completion.py carries four distinct concerns: verification orchestration, child-closure gate, epic bug-screen DET layer, and verdict reconciliation that must split into separate modules
completion_recovery.py carries three distinct concerns: completion criteria contract and bounds, failure taxonomy, and recovery orchestration that must split into separate modules

decomposed modules must re-export public symbols to preserve existing stable seams (rebar.llm.completion.* and rebar.llm.workflow.completion_recovery.*) so that all test monkeypatch targets and import paths remain valid
all moved symbols must be string-swept as dotted paths across src and tests to ensure no orphaned patch targets or dynamic import strings exist after the refactor
the refactor is behavior-preserving with zero assertion changes; only import paths and monkeypatch targets are updated in test files
